Rooms.Name: #cOutside the #N#CT#ch#wrill #N#CK#ci#wll #N#CK#cu#wlt#N
Rooms.Description:
You are standing outside a stone structure looking in, how sad. 
Do you think you have what it takes to get past the animated stone 
monk of the Kult?  If you belong here you have no fears otherwise.  
Well step forward and see.  Don't worry you can only die once.  On 
the other hand how slowly you die is completely up to us.  You note 
that most women are permitted to exit and enter, but one can only 
guess if it is at their leisure.

Rooms.Name: #cEntrance Hallway#N
Rooms.Description:
You are in the main hallway of the Kult.  Mounted on walls and
in cases all around you see prizes won in battle, like the broken
#Cspear#N of the Avatar and the shattered pitch #Cfork#N of Satan, 
won when the clan went hunting in Hell.  You also see the skins and 
skulls of many monsters slain in the hunt.  Tiamat is here stuffed 
like a teddy #Cbear#N, she doesn't look so tough now does she?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The hide of the Queen of the Dragons is here, stuffed.  Even in death 
you can tell she was a fearsome foe when she was alive.

The pitch fork of the former ruler of hell.  With the paladins dead 
we had to kill satan too, less he got out of control.

This is the spear of the Holy Avatar.  No longer holy now that he is 
dead. Call us sinners huh?  See what he got?

Rooms.Name: #cHallway in the Fort#N
Rooms.Description:
One word - amazing.  You have to keep your hands locked at your 
sides in fear that you might break something and have to pay for it.  
That Aftershock bottle looks mighty expensive.

Rooms.Name: #cGoof off Room#N
Rooms.Description:
What's that bud?  You don't feel like killing anything?  Well
maybe you are one of those punks that like to chat a lot.  Or maybe 
you are one of those slow levelers that bring down the clan average 
*slap*. Oh well if you haven't been kicked out on your rear by now 
you must have some good points, eh?  If you have nothing better to do 
come here and relax, goof, chill, talk yer butt off, play come 
#Cdarts#N.  No one really cares.  But don't expect any privacy here.  
And one more thing, KEEP YOUR SMELLY FEET OFF THE FURNITURE.  Hey 
this stuff costs ya know, and you pay for it right out of your dues.  
If you get bored, catch up on the clan bulletin board, which is 
tacked up on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Can you hit the bullseye?
Careful!  You can take someone's eye out with this thing.

Rooms.Name: #cPrivacy Corner#N
Rooms.Description:
Hmmm, you aren't smooth enough to have your own damn room?  But 
you want to talk in private, huh?  Well come in here and close the 
damn door, it is not like anyone cares what the hell you are talking 
about anyways.

Rooms.Name: #cChambers of the Council#N
Rooms.Description:
You enter a high-pillared regal chamber with ornately carved
marble statues of members past and present.  Long red drapes hang 
from arches around which the heads of various Klan kills are hung 
on display. In the center of this chamber is a small, round oak 
table where the councillors gather on a periodic basis to carry 
out their ruling.

Exits.Description:
When you try to look over the shoulder of the guard you see a room.
A very black room.

Rooms.Name: #cLibrary#N
Rooms.Description:
This is where the clan keeps all of their combat gear.  You
never know when the need to kill someone might arise.  All around you 
see various types of armor and weapons stacked on the #Cshelves#N.  
Some brand new and some old, you can tell from the dried blood 
splattered on some of the items.  If you have extra equipment for 
clan members leave it here.  Don't expect too much thanks it is 
expected of everyone to help out, you watch their backs and they will 
watch yours.  And please, no crap items.  Clan members deserve the 
finest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There are rows of shelves on the walls, please stack your gear
neatly.

Rooms.Name: #cHall of Nails#N
Rooms.Description:
As you peer through the door you see a room filled wall to wall 
with massive speakers thumping to a righteous groove.  Colored lights
pierce through the smoke like daggers allowing you to catch a glimpse 
of some fine young vixens dancing like sluts.  As you try to enter, a
talking piece of clay asks if you're in TKK.  An enormous bouncer in 
a purple suit looms behind him.  Unless you're in TKK you better get 
the hell out while you still can!  Only members are allowed to jam in 
the Hall of Nails.

Rooms.Name: #cMacking Room#N
Rooms.Description:
No personal room?  Have someone's pants you want to get into ready 
and waiting?  Think you are smooth enough to get some?  Come here and 
have some fun.  Try and think with your head, no not that one.  The 
other one, dummy.  When you bring a partner here to do whatever try 
not to get any stains on the #Cbed#N, and keep the noise down.  
Sheesh!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see a lovely queen sized bed here with silk sheets and fluffy
down pillows.

Rooms.Name: #cOrdo Dominus#N
Rooms.Description:
You follow the dark stairs up into the west tower of the fort.  
This semi-circular chamber has a huge tapestry on the east wall 
depicting various heroes of the Klan's past in bloody scenes of 
violence.  There is a small discolored brain on the floor to the 
south. Three chambers surround this room.  From here, the chambers of 
the Ordo Dominus, the ruling council of the Kult.  You had better not 
tally here unless one of them is expecting you...

Exits.Description:
As you approach the discarded cerebral matter, you find yourself
disoriented.  You have reached...

Rooms.Name: #cClan Shrine#N
Rooms.Description:
This is a chapel to the clan gods.  Come here if you want to
pray to them.  Of course nothing much will happen of you do, they 
hate suck ups.  Hey they are more likey to strike you down than help 
you. Besides, Zumdahl is always off sweet talking Clara anyways.  I 
doubt they have time for mortals but leave a little something on the 
#Caltar#N anyways and maybe you'll get lucky.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A whirling vortex of blood pulsates and shimmers before you.

This is an altar devoted to #bZumdahl#N#W the god of smoothness and 
his lady #cClara#N#W the goddess of sex.#N

Rooms.Name: #cThe Ancient Spectre Ruins#N
Rooms.Description:
A grey mist surrounds the ancient spectre ruins of Harad.  Amid 
the ancient ruins of a once mighty castle rises a huge black throne.  
A black throne, carved with figures of ancient creatures and runes or 
power, towers in front of you with a powerful malice.  In this throne 
he rests after great deeds and weaves new diabolical plans.  Tombs of 
great kings and sorcerers long forgotten, raped by time and weather, 
rest here for eternity.  Scattered on the ground lies great 
treasures, items and weapons gathered from vast regions of the world 
and places that do not exist in the mind of the mortal anymore.

Rooms.Name: #cDur's Garden of Dreams#N
Rooms.Description:
The portal leaves no residue upon you as you step through into
this grove located somewhere within the Abyss.  This is HIS home 
where HE resides and allows none to view without his permission.  
Propped up against a corpse lies a writhing soul-rack, an evil device 
whose purpose you would rather not contemplate.  Etched into the 
bleeding rocks are the blasphemous symbols of the Ancient Ones whose 
power flows through this entire area.  Massive demonic forms stand 
around the grove, a sign of power to ward off the presence of the 
pure and vigilant.  You only hope the portal of blood to the south 
holds open long enough for you to flee back through...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A whirling vortex of blood pulsates and shimmers before you.

Rooms.Name: #cGouki's Twisted Realm#N
Rooms.Description:
Impossibly, as you drift here in the utter darkness, you hear that 
you are being assaulted by flashes of unreal color.  The odor here 
feels strange, and you taste a bizarre sound emanating from all 
around.  As you strain to see exactly when you are, you can't imagine 
how anyone  can function in such a state.  You get the impression 
there is a strange apparatus floating just out of the corner of your 
smell.  It tastes like it was constructed so that a person could 
suspend himself from it upside down rather comfortably. You realize 
this must be is Gouki's perch. This is Gouki's Realm.

Rooms.Name: #cAegeus' Crib#N
Rooms.Description:
This is where Aegeus plans all of his greatest deeds and misdeeds.  
Quite frankly this room is a mess.  It looks like gear was just 
dropped where it was taken off.  There is a sign posted on the wall 
and you also see the only really neat thing in here, his computer 
desk.  There is a vast collection of ready to use weapons on the 
walls, books on how to kill people in a number of ways.  You know you 
will be in trouble if he comes and catches you here if you dont' have 
permission.  You notice a large box of #Ccondoms#N in plain view.  
You also see posters of Malcom X and Dr. Martin Luther King.  You 
can't make up your mind about this man, Aegeus.  Is he a saint or a 
devil?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A box of 100 condoms with half almost gone.  "Trojans ribbed for 
her pleasure - Cherry flavored."

Rooms.Name: #cHalls of Terror#N
Rooms.Description:
Your last footsteps echo around you for sometime as you finally
reach the bottom of the steps.  A black mist swirls around you 
obscuring your view of this dark place.  You have entered the lower 
levels where the Klan's secrets may be found, only members of 
exceptional merit are permitted to reside in this place...

Rooms.Name: #cThe Hall of Silk Drapes#N
Rooms.Description:
You enter a long elegant hall with a high-arched roof.  It's 
supported with huge creamy marbled pillars shot through with green 
veins. The whole place is decorated with flowing drapes of silk and 
other luxurious materials.  Only the pampered may grace these halls.

Rooms.Name: #cThe Bridge of Spaceball One#N
Rooms.Description:
You have stepped through a portal to the bridge of Spaceball One.
You are surrounded by idiots trying to capture Lone Starr and his pal,
Barf.  You don't give much for their chances however, since none of
these idiots know how to handle the ships weapon systems. To make
things even worse, #cMicroft #Njust jammed the radar - with
#mstrawberry#N jam! An instant later Lone Starr's ship enters
hyperspace and shoots off towards the stars.  There is a beaming
chamber to the north.  
#YColonel Sanders wanders around aimlessly,trying to look important.#N
#YDark Helmet orders 'Ludicrous speed now!'#N

Rooms.Name: #cClub Momar#N
Rooms.Description:
Chicks seem to dig this room.  The bar at the north end of the 
room always has two to three girls waiting for a young man (or woman) 
to pick them up and bring em down to the Mackin' Room. (After a few 
shots they look much cuter).  So why don't ya have a couple brewskies 
on the house and chill out a while.  The DJ is playing the same damn 
song over and over... wait... maybe not, it's just The Smiths.  Do me 
a favor and turn off those stupid disco lights on yer way in.  Oh 
yeah if ya gotta puke, stumble down the hall  and knock on Gouki's 
door he will probably be doin the same.

Rooms.Name: #cSmiley's Stink Machine#N
Rooms.Description:
Your nose practically leaps from your face and takes off as you 
stand just outside the door.  You think, "My god, what is that 
smell?!"  Now that you ventured inside, your fears materialize.  You 
can almost see the foul #yodor#N rising from the floor, which you can 
only assume is somewhere beneath your feet, hidden by the mountains 
of clutter.  There is some furniture, but what you couldn't begin to 
decipher.  You start to feel faint and your lungs #rexplode#N with 
#rfiery#N pain.  You look frantically for a way out of this room, 
longing for the #cfresh#N,#w sweet air#N. "You should have brought a 
gas mask," someone snickers from behind you.

Rooms.Name: #cThe Terrorist's Hide Out#N
Rooms.Description:
#WYou walk down the steps into a #Mdark #Wcellar filled with 
strange objects.  To the #Cleft #Wyou notice a list of #Cnames #Wof 
people who have been killed, all with #rchecks #Wnext to them.  To 
the #Cright #Wyou notice a wall full of #Cweapons#w.  All over the 
#Cfloor #ware papers with recipies for #Mdestruction#W.  The only way 
out is the way you came in. Don't be #mSPOTTED #wbecause you might be 
next on his list if he finds out.#N

Rooms.Name: #cChe's Bathroom#N
Rooms.Description:
As you fumble around in the darkness you accidently hit the 
lightswitch. The scene before you almost strikes you down. Used 
underwear and dirty paper covers the wall and floor. The bathtub is 
filled with a black stinking liquid that makes your nostrils burn. 
The sink is filled with dead bugs that float on a sea of yellowish 
water As you feel sick you cautiously approach the toilet. You slowly 
open the lid...

Che flies in from below.

He says "Hey, get the #RHell#N out of my room!!

Che suddenly circles around you and stabs you in the back.
§N

Rooms.Name: #cThe #wTemple #cof #RDrakken#N
Rooms.Description:
You leave the canopy of Yavin 4's #Gjungle #Ncanopy and enter a
gigantic ebony temple which once was dedicated to the #MDark lord of 
the sith#N, Exar Kun.  The temple is now under the control of Drakken 
and he uses it to send aid to the #CRebel Alliance#N from the 
EliteMUD #GGUERILLAs#N.  In a corner of the temple there is a crate 
full of #Rheavy blaster pistols#N.  On the walls are posters of 
Drakken's idols such as Eldridge Cleaver, Timothy Leary, and Abby 
Hoffman.
§N

Rooms.Name: #cEdge of Forever#N
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the edge of forever, at the end of the
universe.  The land on which you stand was once a thriving sea-shore,
teeming with life on all levels.  As you stroll, you habitually 
adjust your eyesight, still searching for the last vestiges of any 
other life. You remember a time when all one had to do was glance in 
any direction, with any level of vision, to see myriad patterns of 
birth and rebirth. All that could be found now was fast decaying 
remains, as even the smallest organism collapsed back into its 
constituent atoms.  Perhaps it was only a matter of time until even 
the atoms themselves devolved into their own form of death, leaving 
nothing but the ultimate building blocks of the universe once more.
   Stretching your senses to the limit, you observe the death throes
of a star, hoping to see once more the energy of a nova, but seeing 
only the collapse of the complex inter-atomic forces.  Casting your 
eyes about you, you can see the same happening to your home; the 
planet which nurtured and supported your race through billions of 
years of evolution. It was as though the universe was tired of its 
own existence, and is finally opting for the darkness.

Rooms.Name: #cDanzig's Domain#N
Rooms.Description:
A chill runs down your spine as you hear the rumblings of White
Zombie's "Soul Crusher" as you enter the domain of the legendary 
warrior Danzig, he who has stalked the lands of Elite since the time 
of Apollo and the Shadowblade.  On the far wall you see the symbol of 
the great horned skull, Danzig's personal seal, as well as the mark 
of those who he now pledges his ever-faithful allegence, the 
#CT#ch#wrill #CK#ci#wll #CK#cu#wlt#N. There are weapons of death and 
destruction strewn about the room, as well as a great banquet table 
in the center filled with tankards of ale and spirits.  Danzig's 
concubines pay no attention to you as they scurry around you to 
prepare for their Master's return.  You had better hope that Danzig 
is expecting you...for your next breath may be your last....
§N

Rooms.Name: #cDade's Abyss#N
Rooms.Description:
A strange bluish mist seeps along the floor covering your
feet entirely. All around the room scamper strange mobs, each
disfigured in some odd way, a Warg walks around blindly uttering 
strange words, not attacking, a minor demon flies by petting a 
rabbit. On the far right wall, you see an odd picture that seems to 
be morphing itself.. at one time it looks like Dade, at other times 
it looks like Krygian. Two beedy #Rred#N eyes stare at you from 
within a strange, glowing gate on the back wall.. a portal of some 
sort you guess. You walk a bit closer to examine those eyes.. only to 
uncover a dark, cloaked wizard grin with his hellstaff pointed 
straight at you, and the message "#CF#cE#wAR #CT#cK#wK#N" in your 
mind!
§N

Rooms.Name: #cBeatdown Palace#N
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this place of hate, you feel as if something is 
watching you.  You glance at the wall and see a #Cpicture#N.  The 
eyes seem #rred#N and move along with you.  On the floor, a 
#Mmedallion#N symbolizing a man being chopped in half.  You better 
hope you have some juice left in your can of whupass or else you'll 
end up like the skeleton over there.
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see what you believe to be a skeleton of a human, its eyes seemed 
to have been gouged out and it's massively decapitated.

On the wall hangs a picture of a massive being with blood dripping 
from its eyes, and sweat hanging from its chin.
A man has felt the wraith of a chainsaw in full motion.

Rooms.Name: #cThe Last Chamber#N
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a small room without any windows. 
This is where the Council of the Kult come up with new plots against 
the other clans of Elite. Since the guard let you enter here, you must 
be one of them. Remember that the secrets that you discover here NEVER 
shall leave this chamber.

Rooms.Name: #cThe Cave Of Kyre Banorg#N
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself at the mouth of the Cave Of Kyre Banorg. 
Wherein, carved in mystic runes upon the very living rock, the last 
words of Ulfin Bedweer of Regett proclaim the last resting place of 
the most Holy Grail. The bones of four and fifty men lie strewn about 
a small #rrabbit#N. Yet as you approach the voice of TimTheEnchanter 
whispers "Look, that rabbit's got a viscious streak a mile wide, it's 
a killer. He's got huge, sharp-- he can leap about-- look at the 
bones".
§N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well, that's no ordinary rabbit. That's the most foul, cruel, and
bad-tempered rodent you ever set eyes on.

It reads, 'Here may be found the last words of Joseph of Aramathea. 
He who is valiant and pure of spirit may find the Holy Grail in the 
Castle of uuggggggh'.

Rooms.Name: #cInside the Cave#N
Rooms.Description:
As you push into the opened mouth of the cave thoughts dart 
through your mind, and you find it hard to remember why you came here 
in the first place.  Fewer corpses litter the floor, perhaps the 
danger has passed, or perhaps fewer people made it this far into the 
depths.  Your senses prickle and you are snapped back into reality... 
was that a voice you heard around the corner?
§N

Rooms.Name: #cAround the Sharp Corner#N
Rooms.Description:
Rounding the corner, you come face to face with a living 
nightmare. Hacked and maimed bodies have been tossed around the room 
like children's toys.  Although most of the corpses have been long 
dead, a single body still twitches in it's death throughs.  Who are 
whatever caused this carnage can not be far from here.  Tearing your 
vision away from the carnage you see that the cave punges deeper into 
the earth.
§N

Rooms.Name: #cDeep Within the Cave#N
Rooms.Description:
Leaving the carnage of the death scene behind you, you stride 
boldly on.  The stone walls of this terrible place seem close in and 
trap all that would venture into its depths.  Shadows play on the 
irregular surface of the cave and you realize that your enemy could 
be lurking in ambush anywhere.  Legs are heavy with fear and palms 
sweat making the grasp on your weapon difficult to maintain.  Maybe 
talking things over isn't such a bad idea after all.
§N

Rooms.Name: #cThe Darkest of Dungeons#N
Rooms.Description:
You enter the dungeon in search of #BDarklord#N. Rumor has it he
has claimed the life of yet another young soul. You look under his
bed, but find only torn magazines and food wrappers. Wondering where
he could possibly be, you check in the closet. It is full of jackets
from his favorite band, the #CT#ch#wrill #CK#ci#wll #CK#cu#wlt#N. You
wonder if such an awesome jacket will fit on yourself. You take down
the jacket from a rusty coat-hanger and start to try it on. Before
you can even get 1 sleeve in, you feel the rusty hanger enter your
body, rupturing your spleen and slicing your intestines. It looks
like that coat wasn't your style after all.

Rooms.Name: #cRush's Perch#N
Rooms.Description:
You enter the spacious room which is well decorated. A large oak
desk is in the middle of the room, with an oak chair. On the desk there
is some literature, together with a bunch of lilies. The lilies
provide aromatic smell which graces the room. At the end of the room
is a comfortable looking bed, with a soft pillow and silk sheets. There
is a violin at the corner of the room, it is carved with some nice
pattern. On the wall there is a shelf, her favourite clothes are lined
here. The music box stands on the shelf, playing some sweet music.

Rooms.Name: #cZOiD's Den#N
Rooms.Description:
You step in to a spareingly lit room.  As you look around you notices 
heaps of old computer parts lying around among some other crap.  In the 
Corner is a small computer cabinet and a huge stereo pumpin out sound at 
an alarming decibel.  On the floor you notice some strange clotheing, 
apair of PVC pants ,a leather trench coat, a few spiked collars and some 
handcuffs.  You also notice a pair of G strings haning over a chair with 
the name Cissi scratched down on the washing label.

Rooms.Name: #cThe Ancient Tomb of Acrisius#N
Rooms.Description:
This small piece of Enoch has survived over the years through
someones care and protection.  As you look about the room a strange
feeling of safety permeates you, and relaxes you, making you feel 
totally at home.  The walls are made of sandstone and have strange 
script written on them in some forgotten language.  Off to one side 
of the room there is a black marble coffin which seems to exude a 
strange aura of death.  The ceiling is a mural depicting a fight 
between a man of great bueaty and some horrid beast whose flesh seems 
to drip off of him.  In the center of there room there is a small 
table with some items lying on it.

Rooms.Name: #CH#ce#wllfires #gPit of #rBlood #b (and the occasional nap)#N
Rooms.Description:
Upon entering this room, you are amazed to find that despite its name 
there is not one single drop of #rblood#N anywhere in sight. In the 
center of the room against the back wall you see a towering canopy bed 
with beautiful #wwhite #Nsilk curtains encompassing it. Atop the bed are 
dozens of satin pillows embroidered with themes from around the globe. 
Upon closer examination, you realize that each tells a similar story. 
One of a great conqueror who has left his mark upon all fronts. The 
images of #rdeath #Nand #gdestruction #Nchill you to the bone. Stepping 
back from the bed, you look around the rest of the room. On the right 
wall stands a tall oak dresser with a mirror framed in brass and etched 
with the most eye-bending pattern you have ever seen. On top of the 
dresser you find not jewelry and combs, but an assortment of the most 
finely crafted daggers. Upon picking one up with a fine detail of 
serpents clutching the handle and rubies inlaid for their eyes, you hear 
a strange sound behind you. Quickly you turn to find that there is 
nothing there. Shaking now, you place the dagger back on the dresser 
and turn towards the window across the room. Looking out on the fields 
to the north of Midgaard, you breathe a sigh of relief and finally 
begin to relax. Suddenly and without warning, a figure springs forth 
from the shadows and places an enchanted mithiril dagger a mere 
millimeter from your lower spine. Before you can scream, he places his 
hand over your mouth and whispers in your ear, "Fool. Always watch 
your back." Smiling, he sheathes the dagger in a silent fluid motion 
and beckons you near. Knowing you are friend has kept you alive this 
day.

Rooms.Name: #CThe Bohemian #CB#ca#wchelor's#C place of escape#N
Rooms.Description:
Negligence, bohemia, immatureness, you name it. The sucker living
in this once beautiful room's a real lazy slackbum. There're paintings
on the walls, expensive ones too but in each there's a dart or two. 
On the floor lie comfortable although rather dirty clothes (who the 
fuck's gonna wash em anyway). A cosy divan is located in front of the
fireplace, or well you can guess there's a divan underneath all the...
hum... stuff. On one of the walls a "wise" saying is nailed.

        Tomorrow you will have no idea what you did today,
        so why worry about what the fuck you do?

Oh my god, he must've written that himself don't you think? The smirk
on your face keeps growing when you realize that under the divan the
owner's located. You wonder how the hell you could miss that snoring.
#cBaltazar#N for sure don't look very good after yesterday's party.
Because you know, #cBalt#N don't really have the physique that it
takes to party with the #CK#cu#wlt#N.

Rooms.Name: #cStarlet's #gJ#Gu#gn#Gg#gl#Ge #cDomain#N
Rooms.Description:
You wonder if you still are inside the clanhouse or if you
in some magical way have been transported into a weird jungle.
#GVines#N climb all over the walls, reaching for the cracked ceiling
where you can see the #ystars#N shine through. Pillows are scattered
all over the floor, adding a comfortable touch. You can see the tip
of a #wtail#N sticking out from a specially huge pillow-pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Though you could have sworn it was in the middle of the 
day when you entered this room, you can see the #enight 
sky#N through the broken ceiling. You stare at the 
stars for a while and suddenly one blinks at you. 

Go on, make a wish!

It's just like a piece of Miqi'erke has moved into the 
room! Starlet can not live with her kind in the jungle, 
so the jungle has to live with her. A sacrifice the 
#Gnature#N is willing to make, for its more than amazing 
daughter.

It reminds you of someone... You start to remove pillow 
after pillow and when you have removed a few you can see 
that there is a wicked little #cfeline#N lying under 
them. You must have waken her up cause she blinks a few 
times and then opens her big #ggreen#N eyes and stares 
back at you. You can only pray to the gods that she is 
in a good mood.
It's #edark#N and filled with #ystars#N. Beautiful.

She is bizarre, but still interesting. A combination 
of a woman and a cat. #wWhite fur#N covers her slender 
body and the only colourful spot is her eyes, which are 
#gemerald green#N. Starlet looks a lot like the ancient 
mother of all Rit'i, Yuraq.

Objects.Name: statue monk thrill kult tkk
Objects.Description: An animated statue of a cloaked monk stands guard.

Objects.Name: board bulletin thrill kult tkk
Objects.ShortDescription: a Thrill Kill Kult clan bulletin board
Objects.Description: The Thrill Kill Kult clan bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

Objects.Name: lemonade fountain
Objects.Description: a fountain of lemonade stands here.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A small white fountain is standing here, gurgling happily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is very nice.  Made from fine white marble.

Objects.Name: atm teller bank machine
Objects.Description: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

Objects.Name: big guy
Objects.Description: #YA Big Guy blocks the way north.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This strong man is often called Big Guy. His job is to stop people 
from sneaking into the chamber where the council have important 
meetings. For a second you think that you could trick him and quietly 
sneak in through the door, you drop that thought very quickly when 
Big Guy stares at you with rage in his eyes.

Objects.Name: greedy midget
Objects.Description: #YA greedy midget in a hood stands here.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This short and fat little fellow is wearing a black hood that is at 
least one size too big for him. Smiley hired him for guarding The 
Library and that means that he have to stay here for the rest if his 
life. Watching people sleep and change equipment is not the most fun 
thing you can do so the midget got bored pretty fast. Don't feel sorry 
for him, this job pays well.

Objects.Description: The Thrill Kill Kult Council board is mounted on a wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A scorching fountain bubbles over at your toes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#BDarklord#N's fountain is heated by the very core of the world
in which we live. The heated blood fades into the cracks on the floor in
which you are now standing. Carved into this intricate fountain are the
succubi and the wretched of whom the great man himself hath slain.
An inscription upon the lip of the only portion cleansed catches your eye.
You will be my next victim!

Objects.Name: statue darklord
Objects.Description: The carving of the great man, the Darklord himself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A complete replica of Darklord, this statue poses as much a threat
as the actual person. With his long black cape, sparkling staff, and
the face of absolute evil, this crystallized statue reminds us of the
greatest magician, the most deviant, and the wisest leader that ever
roamed this realm.
